'''''Z-Ram''''' was an [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] that attacked [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[C-3 passenger liner]] ''[[Excalibur]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
